ruled_out_vectors.vector: Cetus pattern: overflow at extreme tick prices

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Low-liquidity truncation harvesting

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Fee rounding direction manipulation (Balancer V2 pattern)
ruled_out_vectors.evidence: test_C27_feeRoundingDirection — Verified FullMath.mulDivRoundingUp >= mulDiv for all test amounts. Difference is exactly 1 when remainder exists. FeeHelper uses mulDivRoundingUp for output swap fees (protocol-favorable) and mulDiv for input swap fees (user-favorable on fees, but protocol-favorable net effect since lower fees mean more goes to pool)

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Partial fill fee adjustment underflow in unchecked block
ruled_out_vectors.evidence: Manual code review: AMMModule._poolSwapByInput lines 1413-1427. Partial fill adjustments use mulDiv (proportional) in unchecked block. All intermediate values bounded by originalAmountIn (which was already validated). exchangeFeeAdjustment ≤ exchangeFeeAmount ≤ adjustedAmountSpecified. protocolExchangeFeeAdjustment ≤ protocolExchangeFeeAmount ≤ protocolFeeFromFees. No underflow possible.

ruled_out_vectors.evidence: Manual code review: Constants.sol POOL_TYPE_ADDRESS_MASK requires 6 leading zero bytes (48 bits). CREATE2 brute-forcing 2^48 attempts (~281 trillion) is computationally infeasible for any practical attacker to find a collision that deploys malicious code at a valid pool type address.

summary: Exhaustive precision-sniper audit of the Limit Break AMM. All 10 Forge exploit tests pass — no profitable attacks found. 20 attack vectors ruled out with high confidence via Forge tests and deep manual code review. The codebase is well-hardened at the invariant level: rounding consistently favors the protocol, reentrancy guards are comprehensive (transient storage with flags), fee accounting is correct across all swap paths (input, output, multi-hop, direct, partial fill), and the concentrated liquidity math follows the battle-tested Uniswap V3 patterns correctly. The protocol fee validation in _validateProtocolFees creates a defense-in-depth against pool type bugs. Aderyn static analysis found 1 H-1 (admin-only reentrancy — FP) and 9 lows (informational). Slither found 30 issues, all false positives. No Medium+ findings identified.
